package: GitHub Release assets on the tag: one self-contained `ch` binary (CLI + MCP server) per platform, 7 platforms plus checksums.txt. Every binary is covered by verified GitHub build provenance and publication followed two independent byte-identical builds of the same commit.

config.note: cork-defaults.json is a versioned surface of this component. Installs runtime-fetch it from the main branch (TTL-cached) as the living-field channel; the content at this tag is pinned here by digest.

notices: Review level is unreviewed and stage is partner-preview: no production support commitment attaches to this component version.

Relative to the prior Distribution pin, the covered CLI/MCP surface is breaking: the input and JSON provenance mode `centralized` became `hybrid`. The covered surface of 0.4.1 itself is unchanged from 0.4.0.
Rollover artifacts use the deployed rc.2 wire with signed `jitMarketHash`; rollover remains excluded from this Distribution.
Venue listings accept only fraction-string `premiumAnnualized` (for example, `0.041` means 4.1%); the legacy percent-number `premium` field is refused locally.
On SIGTERM or SIGINT, the MCP server drains in-flight requests for at most five seconds before exiting cleanly.

Embedded HyperSync requires writable, executable or mappable temporary storage. Windows x64 and Linux arm64-musl binaries have no embedded Envio binding and cannot provide full-decentralized HyperSync reads.
This version pins the market-registry 0.3.3 and phoenix v1.3.0-rc.1 addresses on both chains.
Distribution channel: the pinned integration channel is the GitHub Release binaries above. SDK tarballs, OCI, apk and the hosted CVM deployment are not part of this Distribution pin.
